QuestInfo.0: You gave information to #p1002104# too. The only thing left is...

0.0: I should get back to the #m150000000# and get #b#p1401001##k to look into these developments. It may seem frivolous, but I'm sure there's something there.

1.0: Hey there, boss. I was analyzing your face on the monitor earlier. Looked like you found something pretty big. \r\n#L0##b(You tell her about the conversation with #p1404000# in detail.)#l\n#k
1.1: You always end up with gold in your hands, don't you, boss? If Orchid really is using the Black Wings for her own ends, we may be able to make peace. \r\n#L0##bAs optimistic as I'd like to be, I don't know that they're just going to swap over to being our friends after all the fighting.#l\n#k
1.2: If the people at the top of their organization are withholding that kind of information, it's only a matter of time before the in-fighting starts. We just need to keep an eye out for the right opportunity for your brand of talking... \r\n#L0##bUgh, I hate having to interrogate people. I'd rather just sneak in and steal their information when they aren't looking.#l\n#k
1.3: Whatever you say, boss. You may not like it, but you're pretty good at it.

yes.0: For now, we'll just have to wait for them to slip up. #bThis might be a good time for you to get back to your training#k, dontcha think? The next guy you fight isn't gonna be #o9300500#.
